import {
  internalAction,
  internalMutation,
  internalQuery,
  type MutationCtx,
} from "./_generated/server";
import { components } from "./_generated/api";
import { makeFunctionReference } from "convex/server";
import { listMessages } from "@convex-dev/agent";
import { v } from "convex/values";
async function seedApp(ctx: MutationCtx, userId: string, appId: string) {
  const thread = await ctx.runMutation(components.agent.threads.createThread, {
    userId,
    title: "fixture",
  });
  await ctx.db.insert("apps", {
    appId,
    userId,
    name: "fixture",
    platforms: ["web"],
    features: [],
    expoAccountId: null,
    agentRemoteUnresolved: false,
    agentResumeBusy: false,
    agent: {
      threadId: thread._id,
      status: "idle",
      pending: [],
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    },
  });
  return { threadId: thread._id };
}
export const setup = internalMutation({
  args: { userId: v.string(), appId: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx, { userId, appId }) => {
    const app = await seedApp(ctx, userId, appId);
    await ctx.db.insert("publicAdmissionTransport", {
      userId,
      mode: "low",
      calls: 0,
    });
    return app;
  },
});
export const setupApp = internalMutation({
  args: { userId: v.string(), appId: v.string() },
  handler: (ctx, { userId, appId }) => seedApp(ctx, userId, appId),
});
export const markDeleting = internalMutation({
  args: { userId: v.id("users") },
  returns: v.null(),
  handler: async (ctx, { userId }) => {
    await ctx.db.patch(userId, { deletionRequestedAt: Date.now() });
    return null;
  },
});
export const mode = internalMutation({
  args: { mode: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx, { mode }) => {
    const row = await ctx.db.query("publicAdmissionTransport").first();
    if (!row) throw new Error("missing adapter");
    await ctx.db.patch(row._id, { mode });
  },
});
export const armPair = internalMutation({
  args: { mixed: v.boolean() },
  handler: async (ctx, { mixed }) => {
    const row = await ctx.db.query("publicAdmissionTransport").first();
    if (!row) throw new Error("missing adapter");
    await ctx.db.patch(row._id, {
      mode: mixed ? "pair-mixed" : "pair-ok",
      releaseAt: row.calls + 2,
    });
  },
});
export const transportCalls = internalQuery({
  args: {},
  handler: async (ctx) =>
    (await ctx.db.query("publicAdmissionTransport").first())?.calls ?? 0,
});
export const observe = internalMutation({
  args: { method: v.string(), body: v.any() },
  handler: async (ctx, { method, body }) => {
    if (
      method !== "customers.get_or_create" ||
      typeof body.customer_id !== "string"
    )
      throw new Error("unexpected request");
    const row = await ctx.db.query("publicAdmissionTransport").first();
    if (!row) throw new Error("missing adapter");
    if (body.customer_id !== row.userId) throw new Error("unexpected customer");
    await ctx.db.patch(row._id, { calls: row.calls + 1 });
    return { mode: row.mode, ordinal: row.calls + 1, releaseAt: row.releaseAt };
  },
});
export const transport = internalAction({
  args: { method: v.string(), body: v.any() },
  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
    const observation: { mode: string; ordinal: number; releaseAt?: number } =
      await ctx.runMutation(
        makeFunctionReference("publicAdmissionFixture:observe") as any,
        args,
      );
    const { mode, ordinal, releaseAt } = observation;
    if (mode.startsWith("pair-")) {
      if (releaseAt === undefined) throw new Error("missing pair barrier");
      let released = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        const calls: number = await ctx.runQuery(
          makeFunctionReference("publicAdmissionFixture:transportCalls") as any,
          {},
        );
        if (calls >= releaseAt) {
          released = true;
          break;
        }
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25));
      }
      if (!released) throw new Error("pair barrier timed out");
      return {
        balances: {
          credits: {
            remaining: mode === "pair-mixed" && ordinal === releaseAt ? 9 : 10,
          },
        },
      };
    }
    if (mode === "error") throw new Error("synthetic provider failure");
    return mode === "low"
      ? { balances: { credits: { remaining: 9 } } }
      : mode === "ok"
        ? { balances: { credits: { remaining: 10 } } }
        : {};
  },
});
export const seedActive = internalMutation({
  args: { userId: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx, { userId }) => {
    const paidUntil = Date.now() + 600000;
    const sessionId = await ctx.db.insert("computeSessions", {
      userId,
      state: "active",
      paidUntil,
      activation: "active",
    });
    const debitId = await ctx.db.insert("computeDebits", {
      sessionId,
      state: "confirmed",
      paidUntil,
    });
    await ctx.db.patch(sessionId, { debitId });
    return { sessionId, debitId };
  },
});
export const seedStartingClaim = internalMutation({
  args: { userId: v.string(), appId: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx, { userId, appId }) => {
    const app = await ctx.db
      .query("apps")
      .withIndex("by_appId", (q) => q.eq("appId", appId))
      .unique();
    if (!app || app.userId !== userId || !app.agent)
      throw new Error("missing app");
    const sessionId = await ctx.db.insert("computeSessions", {
      userId,
      state: "starting",
      paidUntil: 0,
      activation: "fresh",
    });
    await ctx.db.patch(app._id, {
      agent: {
        ...app.agent,
        status: "processing",
        computeSessionId: sessionId,
      },
    });
    return sessionId;
  },
});
export const snapshot = internalQuery({
  args: { userId: v.string(), appId: v.string(), threadId: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx, { userId, appId, threadId }) => {
    const app = await ctx.db
      .query("apps")
      .withIndex("by_appId", (q) => q.eq("appId", appId))
      .unique();
    const sessions = await ctx.db
      .query("computeSessions")
      .withIndex("by_userId", (q) => q.eq("userId", userId))
      .take(10);
    const messages = await listMessages(ctx, components.agent, {
      threadId,
      paginationOpts: { numItems: 10, cursor: null },
    });
    const row = await ctx.db.query("publicAdmissionTransport").first();
    const debits = sessions[0]
      ? await ctx.db
          .query("computeDebits")
          .withIndex("by_sessionId", (q) => q.eq("sessionId", sessions[0]._id))
          .take(10)
      : [];
    return {
      app,
      sessions,
      debits,
      messages: messages.page,
      calls: row?.calls,
    };
  },
});
